meaning:
ἀθῷος (Rec. wrongly, -ῶος; LS, see word; Mayser, 131), -ον
(θωή, a penalty), [in LXX chiefly for נקה ni., pi., נָקִי ;]
1. unpunished (MM, VGT, see word).
2. innocent: Mat.27:4 (WH, R, mg., δίκαιον) 27:24.
(AS)

elsewhere.note: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”
